scenes.title: Five worlds, one box
scenes.action: One shape per tool arrives on each motif note in its listing's colour; the App Toolkit icon pops on 2.5, the shapes swing round it and the name lands.

scenes.title: Water Eject
scenes.action: The blue world opens from Water Eject's shape. The phone leans back so its speaker faces the camera; a sound wave leaves the speaker holes on every note and pushes bubbles out.

scenes.title: Ruler & Protractor
scenes.action: The yellow world bursts open. Two phones turn in: the Surface Ruler measures as the drawn ruler's band grows, and the Protractor sweeps to 45 degrees on four beats.

scenes.title: Unit Converter
scenes.action: The mint world opens. Five categories, one per beat: the chip selects it, the unit cards flip to its pair (1 m = 100 cm, 500 g = 0.5 kg, 20 °C = 68 °F, 2 L = 2000 mL, 1 GB = 1000 MB) and the phone shows the same conversion.

scenes.title: Tip & Bill Splitter
scenes.action: The peach world opens. A receipt slides out from behind the phone and prints line by line: the bill, the tip, then each person's share.

scenes.title: Decision Wheel
scenes.action: The lilac world opens. The six choices arrive on the wheel one by one, it spins and settles on Music on 22.5, the pick lifts out, confetti bursts and the phone shows the pick.

scenes.title: Everyday tools, one app
scenes.action: The five worlds return as tiles, one per note, then more tools from the app join as chips.

scenes.title: App Toolkit
scenes.action: The icon returns; confetti, bubbles and a sound wave leave it together; the name and Available on Google Play land and hold.
